constraints.constraint: React Hook Form + Zod validation pattern - All forms must use React Hook Form with zodResolver for validation (established in Stories 27-29)
Component file size ≤ 500 lines - Refactor if exceeding limit (from Story 24 patterns)
Responsive layout - Mobile-first design with Tailwind breakpoints (md:, lg:) for tablet/desktop
Accessibility WCAG 2.1 AA - ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, focus states required
Backward compatibility - New OAuth2 auth type must not break existing auth flows (none, api_key, bearer, basic)
Scope validation pattern - Custom scopes must match regex: /^[a-z_]+:[a-z_]+$/ (e.g., read:user)
Security - Client secrets must use password input type (masked in UI), OAuth2 URLs must be HTTPS
UI consistency - Use bg-gray-50 rounded-md for auth config sections matching existing patterns (lines 143, 183, 200)
Test coverage - Minimum 80% test coverage with unit tests for components and integration tests for form submission
TypeScript strict mode - All new components and types must compile with TypeScript strict mode enabled
